$comment: TEST FIXTURE -- the TOOLCHAIN repository, for `nen shu tools`. It carries a dependency block (so the nen row has somewhere to come from), and a project.toolchain that covers all four versionFrom members and four installers between them: one nen runs, one that is declared and not enabled in this release, one with nothing to install, and one verify-only. Its lane's stack is `nextjs` so the advisory packMinimum column has a profile to read. Not shipped; see ../../README.md.

dependency.name: nen
dependency.minimum_semantics: MAJOR.MINOR. While nen's line is 0.x this means >=0.3.0 <0.4.0 EXACTLY -- at major zero the MINOR is the breaking-change vehicle, so a higher minor is out of range in both directions.
dependency.version_probe_output: a bare semver on stdout, e.g. '0.3.0' -- no 'v' prefix, no other text

node.why: engines.node in package.json. A runtime install is a system-wide decision with five common answers; nen probes and prints the pin.

pnpm.why: packageManager in package.json -- the one install nen performs, at the version this repository itself pins.

placeholder-jdk.why: This toolchain prints its version on STDERR, which is why the closed versionFrom set has a member for it.

placeholder-sdk.why: The probe answers with a PATH rather than a version: presence is the whole check, which is what this member says.

placeholder-wrapper.why: This lane resolves the tool through its own committed wrapper, so there is nothing to install.
